summary: Template reader (vertical band alignment + 15x12 hand ascii templates + left-edge/12.04px pitch localisation + cell-centre ink EOS) scores exact match 1.000 and CER 0.000 on dev_main (400), all lengths 1-8 correct.
On 24 traced cases the minimum top1-top2 logit margin is 0.16 on character steps (normalised agree-minus-disagree units) and >= 4.86 on EOS steps.
The design depends on fixed 20px DejaVu Sans Mono geometry (15-row glyphs, 12.04px pitch, tops rows 6-10); other sizes/fonts would need pitch and scale estimation.
